supported_statement: Jeonju has an enduring tradition of hanji, Korean handmade paper. Its Hanji Museum presents paper culture and offers papermaking experiences; its Millennium Hanji Center preserves and teaches traditional production.
proposal_scope: Sources establish Jeonju’s paper tradition. They do not establish an existing Neenah–Jeonju sister-city relationship; that is the speaker’s proposed possibility.
